question: Which CRISPRi system was used to repress competing pathways in S. marcescens?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%CRISPRi%' OR text ILIKE '%dCas9%' OR text ILIKE '%interference%' ORDER BY page, top
SELECT id, page, text FROM sentences WHERE text ILIKE '%CRISPR%' ORDER BY page
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%repress%' OR text ILIKE '%knockdown%' OR text ILIKE '%sgRNA%' OR text ILIKE '%dead Cas%' OR text ILIKE '%competing%' ORDER BY page, top
SELECT id, page, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%CRISPR%' OR text ILIKE '%repress%' OR text ILIKE '%knockdown%' OR text ILIKE '%sgRNA%'

rendered: The document does not name any CRISPRi system that was used to repress competing pathways in S. marcescens. The only mention of CRISPRi is in the review's discussion of limitations, which states that regulatory tools such as CRISPRi and CRISPRa are lacking[1]. The competing-pathway repression it does describe relies on other means, such as competing-pathway deletion and dynamic regulation, not on a CRISPRi system.
